markers.name: stream

markers.name: prefetch
markers.semantics: The access is expected soon enough that an implementation may initiate translation or cache activity early; the instruction itself still executes normally.

markers.name: temporary
markers.applicability: Instructions that produce a register result.
markers.semantics: The produced value is expected to have a short live range.

markers.name: persistent
markers.applicability: Instructions that produce a register result.
markers.semantics: The produced value is expected to have a long live range.

markers.name: independent
markers.semantics: Alias analysis found no dependency on adjacent independently marked instructions; implementations must preserve architectural dependencies regardless.

markers.name: reuse
markers.semantics: The logical call and window transition are unchanged; an implementation may reuse resident physical backing when it can prove the architectural window remains isolated.

markers.name: leaf
markers.semantics: Software expects the destination not to perform a windowed call. The logical window transition is unchanged and the hint may be ignored.
